task: One QEC cycle of the 3-qubit bit-flip memory (|0_L⟩ and |1_L⟩), lookup Pauli frame + majority readout
noise_text: Depolarizing p1 on sx/x, p2 on cx, p_idle per 100 ns that an active qubit idles (explicit id markers sized by each layer's duration), symmetric readout error p_meas.

candidates.family_text: Two ancillas, CNOTs in check order (d0→a0, d1→a0, d1→a1, d2→a1).

verification.method: noiseless stabilizer simulation of the compiled family/settings for both logical inputs and every single-X injection (syndrome table and decoded logical value must match)
